headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: May 31, 2026**
article:
The Chicago White Sox secured a convincing 7-1 victory over the Detroit Tigers, with Anthony Kay earning the win. Edgar Quero led the Tigers' offense with 2 hits, including a home run, and 2 RBIs. In other action, the Washington Nationals defeated the San Diego Padres 9-4, with Brad Lord earning the win after 2.0 innings of scoreless relief. Manny Machado led the Padres' offense with 2 hits, including a home run, and 2 RBI.

Several key players are dealing with injuries, impacting their team's availability. Harrison Bader has been placed on the 10-day injured list by the San Francisco Giants due to left plantar fasciitis. The Colorado Rockies have placed Welinton Herrera on the 15-day injured list with left elbow inflammation. The Athletics have placed Luis Severino on the 15-day injured list with right arm discomfort. The Cincinnati Reds have placed Pierce Johnson on the 15-day injured list retroactive to May 27, 2026, with right elbow inflammation. The Miami Marlins have placed Andrew Nardi on the 15-day injured list retroactive to May 28, 2026, with a left rib cage stress reaction. The Chicago White Sox have placed Munetaka Murakami on the 10-day injured list with a right hamstring strain.

Several trades and roster moves have taken place. The Detroit Tigers acquired left-handed pitcher Juanmi Vasquez in a trade with the Toronto Blue Jays. The Colorado Rockies traded left-handed pitcher Carson Palmquist to the Washington Nationals for cash. The Philadelphia Phillies traded right-handed pitcher Andrew Baker to the Colorado Rockies for future considerations and international bonus pool money. The Cincinnati Reds traded right-handed pitcher Zach McCambley to the Miami Marlins for right fielder Rece Hinds.

top_news.title: **Padres Fall to Nationals in 9-4 Loss**
top_news.summary: The Washington Nationals secured a 9-4 victory over the San Diego Padres, with Brad Lord earning the win after 2.0 innings of scoreless relief. Manny Machado led the Padres' offense with 2 hits, including a home run, and 2 RBI.

top_news.title: **Royals Fall Short in Texas**
top_news.summary: The Kansas City Royals dropped a 7-6 decision to the Texas Rangers in a closely contested game. Carter Jensen led the Royals' offense with a 2-hit, 1-home run, 3-RBI performance.

top_news.title: **Orioles Edge Blue Jays in Thrilling Finish**
top_news.summary: The Baltimore Orioles secured a 6-5 victory over the Toronto Blue Jays, with Albert Suárez earning the win. Vladimir Guerrero Jr. led the Blue Jays with 4 hits, while Brandon Young pitched 6.2 strong innings for the Jays.

top_news.title: **Giants Place CF Harrison Bader on 10-Day Injured List**
top_news.summary: San Francisco Giants center fielder Harrison Bader has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to left plantar fasciitis. The move was made on May 30, 2026.

top_news.title: **Tigers Acquire Left-Handed Pitcher in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Detroit Tigers made a move on May 27, 2026, acquiring left-handed pitcher Juanmi Vasquez in a trade. Vasquez joins the Tigers after being dealt from the Toronto Blue Jays.
